newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cash JGBs sold slightly due to strong output data.
newsitem.headline: Cash JGBs sold slightly due to strong output data.

text.p: *The benchmark 182nd cash JGB was sold slightly after the forecasts for Japan manufacturers' output in December and January came out stronger than the market's expectations. *Earlier, key March JGBs ended sharply down, due to a sharp fall in Tokyo share prices.
Dealers sold JGBs on speculation that weak Tokyo share prices would cause investors to sell cash JGBs to take profits, traders said.
Investors were not, however, detected actively selling cash JGBs, the trader for a city bank's securities affiliate said.
The March ended at 124.95, down from previous day's 125.30.
The dollar's rise to above 115 yen in morning Tokyo trade on Thursday for the first time in over 44 months, may also have had a depressing effect on JGBs, traders said.
In the interest rate swap (IRS) market, rates in the four-to eight-year zone in particular were up from the previous day, a trader for a long-term credit bank said.
City banks were said to have been paying fixed interest rates, mostly in the four- and five-year zones, the trader said.
The five year IRS rate was quoted at 1.93/97 percent as of 0727 GMT, up from about 1.88/92 percent during the previous day.
The rise in IRS rates over the last few days has been greater than a rise in JGB yields, a trust bank trader said.
